in_sanskrit.name: Parshant
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Supreme Lord
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Parshant एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'Parshva' which means 'Supreme Lord'. The name Parshant is a revered name in Hindu mythology and symbolizes power, wisdom, and divine protection.

The name Parshant is a revered name in Hindu mythology and symbolizes power, wisdom, and divine protection.
